q: DISSOLVED — THE RULE IS GONE. v8 removed the pairing margin entirely, so there is no state for it to bind.
detail:
THE RULE AS FILED: a Chaos Agent coded girl partnered to an Anchor coded girl is ALWAYS 1.5 INCHES SMALLER than her partner — for dominance, brat swagger, and so the top can go feral.

IT DOES NOT SAY WHICH MEASUREMENT. And under v8 there are two: the standardised FLACCID figure every profile records, and the ERECT figure that is labelled explicitly and often omitted.

TORIE AND BRYN SATISFY IT AT BOTH — 10.0 against 11.5, and 10.6 against 12.1. BUT THE ACCOUNT OF HOW THAT HAPPENED IS NOT A RULE, IT IS A DECISION: TORIE WENT BACK, FOUND OUT HOW BIG BRYN WAS HARD, DID THE MATH, AND MADE SURE. A woman does not go back and check something that was already guaranteed.

SO THE LIKELIEST READING IS THAT THE RULE BINDS THE FLACCID RECORD — the standardised figure, the one on the chart — AND TORIE EXTENDED IT TO HARDNESS HERSELF. THAT IS A READING. The Archive is not writing it into cock-standards.

AND IT MATTERS BEYOND THESE TWO, because every other Chaos/Anchor pairing in three houses is governed by the same line. IF THE MARGIN BINDS FLACCID ONLY, then a brat somewhere could be compliant on the chart and closer than 1.5 at full hardness, because the erect gain is a RANGE and not a constant — a brat taking +0.6 against an Anchor taking +0.2 closes four tenths of an inch. A 1.5-inch margin survives that. A NARROWER ONE WOULD NOT, AND NOBODY HAS SAID THE MARGIN IS THE SAME FOR EVERY PAIR.

ALSO STILL UNRECORDED AND NOT INVENTED: ERECT GIRTHS. Both women have a flaccid circumference on file and neither has a hard one, and the permitted gain there is +0.2 TO 0.4.
